in_hindi.name: नानिष्का
in_hindi.meaning: नान (नाना - many) + ईष्का (ईष्क - God, + ा - feminine suffix)

in_marathi.name: Nanishka
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nanishka हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Nani’ meaning grace and ‘Shka’ meaning beautiful. Nanishka is a name of divine beings and is associated with beauty, grace, and purity. In Hindu mythology, Nanishka is a name of Lord Vishnu.
